Ranked defects and suggested fixes

Nothing below has been applied. File:line refs are in this tree at the survey sha.

  1. 1 · Hills are in the wrong places; the brief's mid-lap relief is missing (HIGH, measured)
    Built road height is flat to ±0.2 m from frac 0.40 to 0.75 (Piratella, Acque Minerali, Variante Alta) while the brief (docs/tracks/imola.md §3) asks for a climb to Piratella (~0.35), a drop/climb at Acque Minerali (0.45–0.55), a crest at Variante Alta (~0.65) and a descent into Rivazza (~0.80), with the first third near-flat. Built: +16 m crest at 0.149 (Tamburello T2), −14 m trough at 0.310 (Villeneuve/Tosa), +14 m at 0.85 (Rivazza T17, where the brief says descent), and the start line 9 m below the 0.15 crest. Frames 04/16/40 (flat mid-lap), 02 (Tamburello hill).
    Fix: elevations at js/circuits/imola.js:35-40 look keyed for the racing frame but are fmap'd as control-index fractions (js/track/core/def.js:293), so each bump lands ~0.2–0.5 of a lap off. Re-key (or add a surveyed profile) from a measured racing-frame target, then re-check with verify-track and ground-audit. Do not guess keys: confirm with a.groundProfile/ground-profile.mjs first.
  2. 2 · Spectator-hill bank renders as a flat, unlit olive slab (HIGH visibility, measured symptom, mechanism suspected)
    A large featureless lime/olive quad with a hard dark edge sits trackside on the +1 side at 0.50 and 0.67 laps (frames 04, 05, 16, 22…); no rows, crowd or rise visible. At night it is brighter than the surrounding black ground (frames night-dry 04/05), i.e. it is not lit like terrain. Candidates: spectatorHill 0.505–0.515 (js/circuits/scenery/imola.js:749) and 0.530–0.555 (:561), layered at the same side/gap region (comment at :305 notes a second hill was tris-ratcheted). Fix: inspect the emitted prim/material of those two calls (BANK colour, rows 3–4, rise 1.1–1.2) — likely a collapsed rows/rise or a MAT with no lighting; drop one of the pair if redundant.
  3. 3 · Overcast and fog leave the sky saturated blue (MED, measured)
    Day · overcast frames (37–42) show the same deep-blue sky as dry (frame 01); only the ground tints. Day · fog (43–48) hazes the terrain/trees but the sky above stays blue, giving a hard haze-to-sky seam. Storm/rain/wet do respond (grey sky) after the #1979 merge, so overcast/fog sky colour is the gap. Fix: js/lighting/atmosphere.js weather blend for overcast/fog zenith (engine, not Imola-specific).
  4. 4 · Wet-weather ground and screen-space reflection artefacts (MED, measured)
    Day rain at 0.33 (frame 27) darkens terrain towards dusk levels while the sky is mid-grey; SSR on the tarmac shows stippled/noisy tree and gantry reflections and, at night-rain 0.33, floating white slab reflections of the Tosa stand. Gantry reflection duplicates the frame (frames 19/25). Likely shared renderer; flag to renderer-debug.
  5. 5 · Sparse night illumination (MED, measured frames; cause source/code)
    Night frames show lit pools only where the 3 lamp ranges and car lights reach (0.30–0.68 on the left, 0.84–0.92, 0.95–1.05); the pit straight is nearly dark apart from garage glow, pit/Partenza buildings are unlit despite lit:true (frame night 01), sky is flat black with no horizon glow and terrain beyond the lamp radius is pure black. Fix: add masts at pit/Partenza (scenery/imola.js ~:612-632 pattern) and a night horizon term; dressingExclusions (def :30-33) disables the engine lamps for the whole lap.
  6. 6 · Vegetation reads as a uniform conifer wall vs the deciduous brief (MED, measured)
    Pit run, Tosa exit and 0.67 straight are dense identical layered-cone pines (frames 01, 11, 05) although docs call for broadleaf poplar/willow with "almost no pine" and mid-lap pineFrac:0; code uses pineFrac 0.05–0.25 and scene() counts 139 pines + 1457 trees. River gap: no Santerno ribbon visible on the +1 side at frac 0 (frames 01, 07, 13) though 9 required santerno-water-* calls exist (imola.js:151-158).
  7. 7 · Backdrop mountains are bare low-poly pyramids (LOW, measured)
    Horizon "wooded hills" are small flat-shaded cones above a vast plain (frames 04, 16); sky has no horizon haze despite pal horizon [0.80,0.72,0.56].
  8. 8 · Prop interpenetration at Tosa stands (LOW, measured)
    3 severe clip spots (3.26 / 1.75 / 1.24 m, frac 0.339–0.356) from js/track/scenery/structures.js:808-825 terrace/cut prisms, plus 3 coplanar pairs (1.6 mm gap, z-fights from 91 m). All at baseline; not visible in stills.
  9. 9 · Corner markers verified, minor notes (INFO)
    Markers for T2–T7, T11–T15, T17–T18 sit on built curvature peaks; Tamburello/Tosa/Variante Alta radii 18–46 m. T1 and T8/T16 are gentle (R 383 / 250 / 167 m) so apex stations are inherently uncertain. Built length is 0.8 % short of FIA.
